# ghost/chess

Square Chess (F-Droid): start a game (side, engine level 1-9), play moves like e2e4 one at a time or as a list, read the position (placement, status, opening, move list), take back a move or resign. Offline engine, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/chess
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/chess new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/chess make_move --device <serial> --param move=<move>
ghost skill run ghost/chess make_moves --device <serial> --param moves=<moves>
ghost skill run ghost/chess undo_move --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/chess resign --device <serial> --param confirm=<confirm>
ghost skill run ghost/chess get_board --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Start a chess game as white
- `make_move`: Play e2e4 in chess
- `make_moves`: Play the Italian opening in chess: e2e4, g1f3, f1c4
- `undo_move`: Take back my last chess move
- `resign`: Resign the chess game
- `get_board`: What is the chess position?
